import numpy as np,mujoco
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from search2 import setup

class Balance:
 def __init__(self,s,kp=80,kd=18,rootkp=80,rootkd=18,weight=10):
  self.s=s;self.m=m=s.low.model;d=s.low.data;self.kp=kp;self.kd=kd;self.rkp=rootkp;self.rkd=rootkd
  self.root=d.qpos[:3].copy();self.rot=d.xmat[1].reshape(3,3).copy();self.fp=d.site_xpos[[1,2]].copy();self.fr=d.site_xmat[[1,2]].reshape(2,3,3).copy()
  self.k=mujoco.MjData(m);self.n=75;self.W=np.ones(75);self.W[:6]=1/weight
  self.inds=np.arange(21);self.dofs=np.array([m.jnt_dofadr[m.actuator_trnid[i,0]] for i in self.inds]);self.adrs=np.array([m.jnt_qposadr[m.actuator_trnid[i,0]] for i in self.inds]);self.prev=None
 def jac(self,d):
  J=[]
  for si in (1,2):
   jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv));jr=jp.copy();mujoco.mj_jacSite(self.m,d,jp,jr,si);J.extend([jp[:,:75],jr[:,:75]])
  return np.vstack(J)
 def control(self,tar):
  m=self.m;d=self.s.low.data;n=self.n
  J=self.jac(d)
  self.k.qpos[:]=d.qpos;mujoco.mj_integratePos(m,self.k.qpos,d.qvel,1e-5);mujoco.mj_forward(m,self.k);jdv=(self.jac(self.k)-J)@d.qvel[:n]/1e-5
  b=[]
  for h,si in enumerate((1,2)):
   ep=self.fp[h]-d.site_xpos[si];er=Rotation.from_matrix(self.fr[h]@d.site_xmat[si].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()
   b.extend(np.r_[150*ep,150*er]-25*(J[h*6:h*6+6]@d.qvel[:n]))
  b=np.array(b)-jdv
  a=-self.kd*d.qvel[:n];a[self.dofs]+=self.kp*(tar[:21]-d.qpos[self.adrs])
  a[:3]=self.rkp*(self.root-d.qpos[:3])-self.rkd*d.qvel[:3]
  er=Rotation.from_matrix(self.rot@d.xmat[1].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec();a[3:6]=self.rkp*er-self.rkd*d.qvel[3:6]
  a+=self.W*(J.T@np.linalg.solve((J*self.W)@J.T+1e-7*np.eye(12),b-J@a))
  M=np.zeros((m.nv,m.nv));mujoco.mj_fullM(m,M,d.qM)
  h=(M[:n,:n]@a+d.qfrc_bias[:n])
  jb=J[:,:6].T
  f=np.linalg.lstsq(jb,h[:6],rcond=1e-8)[0]
  tau=h-J.T@f
  out=tar.copy();out[:21]=d.qpos[self.adrs]+(tau[self.dofs]-m.actuator_biasprm[:21,2]*d.qvel[self.dofs])/m.actuator_gainprm[:21,0]
  return out,f

def run(p=(80,18,80,18,10),save=True):
 s,q,lo,hi=setup();d=s.low.data;bc=Balance(s,*p);acts=[];st=[]
 for t in range(1000):
  tar,f=bc.control(q);a=np.clip(2*(tar-lo)/(hi-lo)-1,-1,1);_,_,done=s.step(a);acts.append(a);st.append([*d.xpos[72],*d.xpos[73],*d.qpos[:3],*f])
  if done:break
 st=np.array(st)
 print(p,len(st),st[-1,:9],flush=True)
 if save:np.savez('/app/output/id.npz',actions=acts,stats=st,p=p)
 return len(st),p,st[-1,:9].tolist()
if __name__=='__main__':run()
